name: Takamizawa Jin
source:
Jin is [url=/c1358]Natsuki's[/url] older brother and co-worker of hers and Tatsuya at the restaurant that his father owns. He constantly makes his sister angry, which tends to resulting in him being on the receiving end of Natsuki's ladle throwing technique.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoake_Mae_yori_Ruriiro_na]Wikipedia[/url].]
